opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: Search Ryanair flights from {origin} to {destination} as {trip_type} on {depart_date} (and {return_date}) for {adults} adults, optionally with {promo_code}, and select the offered outbound/return fares.
steps: Open ryanair.com Flights tab
Choose Return trip or One way
Click From field, pick origin country and airport
Click To field, pick destination country and airport
Pick departure date in the calendar (navigate months as needed)
Pick return date if return trip
Set adult passenger count and click Done
Optionally click 'Apply promo code' and enter the code
Click Search
On results, click Select for the outbound flight, then Select for the return flight

instances.values: Return, Dublin -> Athens, 2 Apr - 5 Apr, 1 adult; selected FR4518 / FR4519
One way, Dublin -> Malta, 22 Apr, 2 adults
Return, Tel Aviv -> Venice Treviso, 9 May - 16 May, 1 adult; selected FR912 / FR911
Return, Dublin -> Paris Beauvais, 26 Apr - 2 May, 2 adults, promo code 1000001

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search and ticket selection
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Attractions, find attractions in {destination} for {date}, apply optional filters and sort, open {attraction}, and choose ticket quantities.
steps: Click Attractions tab on Booking.com
Type the destination/attraction in the search box, or browse 'Explore more destinations' by region and click the city
Select the date in the date picker and click Search
Optionally tick filters (Free cancellation, City, Category such as Tours) and choose a sort tab (e.g. Most popular)
Click the chosen attraction / See availability
Pick the date in the attraction's ticket calendar
Set adult/child/infant ticket counts and click Next

instances.values: Aquarium of Paris, 5 May; opened Aquarium of Paris ticket panel
Asia -> Kyoto, 25 May; filters Free cancellation, City Kyoto, Tours; sort Most popular; Fushimi Inari Shrine Hiking Tour, 2 adults + 1 infant, Next

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant search and availability/notify request
opportunities.description: On Resy, set {city}, search for {restaurant_or_cuisine}, open the restaurant, choose {date}/{party_size}, and set a Notify for a {time_window} if no slots are available.
steps: Open resy.com and optionally change the city selector
Type restaurant name or cuisine in the search box
Select the restaurant from the dropdown (or view the results list)
Choose guests and date in the restaurant page date picker
Review time slots; if unavailable click Notify
In Set Notify dialog choose preferred start and end times and click Confirm
